//: Postgres MCP server. Two consumers over the project's life, both LLM-side (never the app services, which use SQLAlchemy directly): (1) Claude Code now, to inspect/query the tinder DB while building instead of shelling into psql; (2) the Day-5 support chatbot's LLM, which calls this same server as a tool for guarded live-data queries. Uses localhost:5432 because Claude Code runs on the host, where compose publishes the DB port.
